# ADR-3240: AWS secrets: Unencrypted EBS snapshot share for account 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Shared snapshots leak disk contents.

## Decision

Operators MUST NOT create an unencrypted EBS snapshot share for account 8 (AWS-secrets-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Shares require encryption and approvals.
